scripts.build: cargo build --manifest-path Cargo.toml --all-targets && cargo doc --manifest-path Cargo.toml --no-deps
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path Cargo.toml && cargo run --manifest-path Cargo.toml --bin aussie_plus_plus -- samples/flag-right-side-up.aussie && cargo run --manifest-path Cargo.toml --bin aussie_plus_plus -- --upside-down samples/flag.aussie
scripts.verify: pnpm run quality:all && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
